modalLead: Every theme is redrawn. Each material now has a surface of its own, with new backdrops to match. A cheat sheet you can search and an add-bookmark form with a live preview come with it.

items.text: Every theme is redrawn. Cards, headers, menus, dialogs and the side panel take the surface of their material: paper reads as an index card, enamel as a glazed tile, neon has a glowing top edge. All 192 theme families are drawn again with it, in light and dark. Aurora Glass is the new default, and every install moved onto it once, with a dialog that shows the theme you had and a Go back button.
items.title: Every theme, redrawn

media.alt: The nextDash dashboard in a redrawn theme: translucent columns over a soft backdrop

items.text: 75 backdrops, and a quiet centre. Each material has patterns of its own and each theme picks one. The Quiet centre slider in the theme studio fades the backdrop behind your bookmarks, so the text stays easy to read and the pattern stays at the edges.
items.title: 75 backdrops, and a quiet centre

media.alt: The theme studio on its Backdrop tab; the Quiet centre slider fades the pattern behind the bookmarks

items.text: Signature or Classic. Under Surface, Material style keeps the new drawing of each material, or brings back the flat surface of before.

Neutrals and ThinkDashboard Classic. The eight neutral themes sit on one lightness ladder, with an accent you pick once for all of them. ThinkDashboard Classic brings back the first page nextDash drew, with its grid of dots; the current one is now ThinkDashboard Modern.
Unraid themes redrawn. Card panels, server colours and a calmer band.
A cheat sheet you can search. A search field, topics in columns and a dock along the bottom that shows the keys of the row you pick and follows the keyboard focus.
items.title: A cheat sheet you can search

media.alt: The cheat sheet: a word typed in the search field narrows the topics, and the dock shows the keys of the row picked

items.text: Shift+G opens Glances from every view. In lists, End goes to the last row; G no longer does.
Add and edit in two columns. The form shows the card as it will look on the dashboard while you type, and the icon picker opens inside the page instead of being clipped.
Inbox. Undo after pasting the same link again keeps one row, and cancelling Promote on a found app leaves no empty category.
Containers. Remove stopped only removes the containers it listed.
Theme studio. Reset all resets the rest of the Surface tab, a second Shift+A while it loads opens the same studio, and a change made on another device keeps your preview.
